messages.subject: Re: CNA frequency plot
parts:
Hi Henrik,

so I successfully generated CN segmentation and calls for my dataset
using GLAD (thanks for your help!),
now, what could be the easiest way to make some kind of summary plot,
showing frequencies and/or sum of aberrations across all samples for
all chromosomes in one plot, without re-inventing the weel? Something
like plotFreqStat() in aCGH package, or a plot(regions) in CGHregions
package?

Thanks!
Ivan

On Mon, Nov 7, 2011 at 2:07 PM, Ivan Smirnov <vany...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hi Henrik,
>
> so I successfully generated CN segmentation and calls for my dataset
> using GLAD (thanks for your help!),
> now, what could be the easiest way to make some kind of summary plot,
> showing frequencies and/or sum of aberrations across all samples for
> all chromosomes in one plot, without re-inventing the weel? Something
> like plotFreqStat() in aCGH package, or a plot(regions) in CGHregions
> package?

This is not provided in the Aroma framework. I suggest that you take
your segmentation tables (cf.
http://aroma-project.org/vignettes/NonPairedCBS), merge them into the
correct format, and pass the data on to for instance those methods you
mentioned.

/Henrik
